SILT#00069: Clue comes from clewe (ball of yarn), which alludes to the ball of yarn used in the myth of the Minotaur's labyrinth that guides Theseus. Now, it might be interesting to see how playing Clue would be different if your characters, alongside finding clue, was chased by a Minotaur
